SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM CLASS C
JOIN CREATOR CR ON C.OPERATOR_CODE = CR.OPERATOR_CODE
JOIN MEMBER M ON CR.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( C.NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR CR.ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' )
AND C.APPROVAL_STATUS = #{search.approvalStatus}
AND C.STATUS = #{search.classStatus}

SELECT *
FROM (
SELECT C.CLASS_CODE, C.NAME AS CLASS_NAME,
C.ADDRESS AS REGION,
NVL( ( SELECT ROUND( ( TO_DATE( MAX(S.END_TIME), 'HH24:MI' ) - TO_DATE( MIN(S.START_TIME), 'HH24:MI' ) ) * 1440 )
FROM SCHEDULE S
JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR ON S.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = CRR.REPEAT_RULE_CODE
WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ), 0 ) AS RUNNING_TIME,
M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME,
CR.ACTIVITY_NAME AS WORKSHOP_NAME,
CAT.NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME,
( SELECT MIN( CRR.OPERATION_START_DATE )
FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR
WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUITMENT_START_DATE,
( SELECT MAX( CRR.OPERATION_END_DATE )
FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR
WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUITMENT_END_DATE,
C.DESIRED_PRICE AS SALE_PRICE,
C.APPROVAL_STATUS,
C.STATUS AS CLASS_STATUS,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY C.WRITE_DATE DESC, C.CLASS_CODE DESC ) AS RN
FROM CLASS C
JOIN CREATOR CR ON C.OPERATOR_CODE = CR.OPERATOR_CODE
JOIN MEMBER M ON CR.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE
JOIN CATEGORY CAT ON C.CATEGORY_CODE = CAT.CATEGORY_CODE
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( C.NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR CR.ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' )
AND C.APPROVAL_STATUS = #{search.approvalStatus}
AND C.STATUS = #{search.classStatus}
)
WHERE RN BETWEEN #{search.startRow} AND #{search.endRow}

SELECT C.CLASS_CODE, C.NAME AS CLASS_NAME,
C.OPERATOR_CODE AS WRITER_CODE,
M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME,
CR.ACTIVITY_NAME AS WORKSHOP_NAME,
CAT.NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME,
C.ADDRESS AS REGION,
NVL( ( SELECT ROUND( ( TO_DATE( MAX(S.END_TIME), 'HH24:MI' ) - TO_DATE( MIN(S.START_TIME), 'HH24:MI' ) ) * 1440 )
FROM SCHEDULE S
JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR ON S.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = CRR.REPEAT_RULE_CODE
WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ), 0 ) AS RUNNING_TIME,
C.STATUS AS CLASS_STATUS,
C.APPROVAL_STATUS,
C.APPROVAL_MEMO,
C.DESIRED_PRICE AS SALE_PRICE,
C.PRICE AS MARKET_PRICE,
CASE WHEN C.PRICE > 0 AND C.DESIRED_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND( ( C.PRICE - C.DESIRED_PRICE ) / C.PRICE * 100 ) ELSE 0 END AS DISCOUNT_RATE,
( SELECT MIN(S.MIN_PEOPLE)
FROM SCHEDULE S
JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR ON S.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = CRR.REPEAT_RULE_CODE
WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS MINIMUM_PEOPLE,
( SELECT MAX(S.MAX_PEOPLE)
FROM SCHEDULE S
JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR ON S.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = CRR.REPEAT_RULE_CODE
WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS MAXIMUM_PEOPLE,
( SELECT MIN( CRR.OPERATION_START_DATE ) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUITMENT_START_DATE,
( SELECT MAX( CRR.OPERATION_END_DATE ) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUITMENT_END_DATE,
( SELECT LISTAGG( CO.OFFERING_NAME, ', ' ) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CO.CLASS_OFFERING_CODE )
FROM CLASS_OFFERING_MAP COM
JOIN CLASS_OFFERING CO ON COM.CLASS_OFFERING_CODE = CO.CLASS_OFFERING_CODE
WHERE COM.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS PERIOD_TYPE,
C.SINGLE_INTRODUCE,
C.INTRODUCE,
C.FINISH_INTRODUCE AS FINISHED_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
FROM CLASS C
JOIN CREATOR CR ON C.OPERATOR_CODE = CR.OPERATOR_CODE
JOIN MEMBER M ON CR.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE
JOIN CATEGORY CAT ON C.CATEGORY_CODE = CAT.CATEGORY_CODE
WHERE C.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode}

SELECT CLASS_IMG_CODE AS IMAGE_CODE,
CLASS_CODE,
TYPE AS IMAGE_TYPE,
IMAGE AS IMAGE_PATH,
SORT_ORDER AS IMAGE_ORDER
FROM CLASS_IMG
WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode}
AND TYPE IN ( '대표', '갤러리' )
ORDER BY CASE TYPE WHEN '대표' THEN 1 WHEN '갤러리' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, SORT_ORDER, CLASS_IMG_CODE

SELECT CLASS_IMG_CODE AS FINISHED_PRODUCT_CODE,
CLASS_CODE,
IMAGE AS FINISHED_PRODUCT_IMAGE
FROM CLASS_IMG
WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode}
AND TYPE = '완성'
ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, CLASS_IMG_CODE

SELECT TAG_CODE, CLASS_CODE, TAG_NAME
FROM TAG
WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode}
ORDER BY TAG_CODE

SELECT S.SCHEDULE_CODE, CRR.CLASS_CODE, S.CLASS_DATE, S.START_TIME, S.END_TIME,
S.MIN_PEOPLE AS MINIMUM_PEOPLE,
S.MAX_PEOPLE AS MAXIMUM_PEOPLE
FROM SCHEDULE S
JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR ON S.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = CRR.REPEAT_RULE_CODE
WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode}
ORDER BY S.CLASS_DATE, S.START_TIME, S.SCHEDULE_CODE

SELECT CURRICULUM_CODE, CLASS_CODE,
CURRICULUM_TYPE AS STEP_NUMBER,
CURRICULUM_TITLE,
CURRICULUM_CONTENT AS CURRICULUM_DESCRIPTION,
CURRICULUM_IMG AS CURRICULUM_IMAGE
FROM CLASS_CURRICULUM
WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode}
ORDER BY CURRICULUM_TYPE, CURRICULUM_CODE

SELECT CLASS_MATERIAL_CODE AS MATERIAL_CODE,
CLASS_CODE,
MATERIAL_NAME,
MATERIAL_CONTENT
FROM CLASS_MATERIAL
WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode}
ORDER BY CLASS_MATERIAL_CODE

SELECT CO.CLASS_OFFERING_CODE AS OFFERING_CODE,
COM.CLASS_CODE,
CO.OFFERING_NAME
FROM CLASS_OFFERING_MAP COM
JOIN CLASS_OFFERING CO ON COM.CLASS_OFFERING_CODE = CO.CLASS_OFFERING_CODE
WHERE COM.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode}
ORDER BY CO.CLASS_OFFERING_CODE

SELECT ADDITIONAL_INFO_CODE,
CLASS_CODE,
ADDITIONAL_INFO_CONTENT AS CONTENT
FROM CLASS_ADDITIONAL_INFO
WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode}
ORDER BY ADDITIONAL_INFO_CODE
